title: Atorvastatin Calcium in Preventing Metabolic Syndrome in Prostate Cancer Patients Receiving Androgen-Deprivation Therapy

sections.abstract: This randomized pilot clinical trial studies atorvastatin calcium in preventing metabolic syndrome in patients with prostate cancer receiving long-term androgen-deprivation therapy. Atorvastatin calcium may help prevent or reduce metabolic syndrome caused by long-term androgen-deprivation therapy
